data.name: Sharutha
data.gender_notes: Sharutha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess Sharutha is the embodiment of love and compassion. She is also known as the goddess of fertility and is often invoked for a successful pregnancy. The name Sharutha carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Malayalam. Parents who choose Sharutha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharutha represents the divine feminine energy and is a symbol of love, compassion, and nurturing. She is also a goddess of fertility and is believed to protect and bless those seeking to start a family.
data.etymology: Sharutha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharutha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
